prompt:
You improve the first-run onboarding of a desktop pet app.

Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 83.5%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 78.3%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 75.3%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 86.4%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 27.6%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Changes already shipped, in order (the current onboarding includes all of them): ['Preset Fast-Track Adoption Flow', 'Move Sign-In after Pet Adoption', 'Photo Quality Assistant Callout', 'Interactive Generation Progress & Tip Carousel', 'Split View Path Selection Screen', 'Custom Pet Style Selector View', 'Split View Story Intro Showcase']
Changes already tested and stopped: ['Spotlight Layout for Final Desktop Welcome', 'Background Rendering Notification Prompt', 'Existing Account Sync Assurance Banner', 'Post-Adoption Certificate Sign-In Placement', 'Desktop Readiness Diagnostic Flow', 'Path Decision Speed Helper Callout', 'Playful Pet Interaction Starter Hub', 'Carousel Choice Card Path Layout', 'Post-Waiting Final Account Sign-In Placement', 'Desktop Overlay Interaction Hints during Waiting', 'Path Choice Flexibility & Multi-Pet Reassurance', 'Pre-Adoption Photo Prep Screen', 'Account Persistence Verification Flow', 'Desktop Visibility Actionable Prompt', 'Estimated Generation Time Progress Indicator', 'Desktop Dock Placement Guidance Banner', 'Companion Archetype Quick Selector Flow', 'Interactive Companion Hatching Progress Bar', 'Photo Quality Interactive Badge Assistant', 'Desktop Control Action Video Card', 'Pet Persistence Account Sign-In Hint', 'Audio Notification Generation Complete Switch']
Ideas the safeguards blocked (they cannot be tested, do not propose them again): ['Interactive Pet Gallery & Live Preview Redesign', 'Desktop Controls Interactive Tutorial Screen', 'Clear Path Choice Value Proposition Copy', 'Adoption Starter Pack Bonus Incentive', 'Pet Customization Safety & Validation Interface', 'Desktop Controls Summary Screen', 'Desktop Launch Checklist View', 'Story-to-Path Guided Walkthrough', 'Stage-Based Pet Adoption Studio', 'Two-Column Adoption Certificate Preview Layout', 'First-Day Accessory Unlock Badge Callout', 'Single-Click Auth Account Link Interface', 'Account Sign-In Recovery Warning Hint', 'Generation Stage Live Updates Indicator', 'Account Sync & Cloud Save Explanation Screen', 'Live Pet Spawn Status Waiting Screen Redesign', 'Pet Personality Trait Customizer Flow', 'Custom Photo Quality Guidance Banner', 'Grid Layout Quick-Start Controls View', 'First Companion Name & Identity Certificate Incentive', 'Story Mode Immersive Selection Layout', 'Waiting Room Prior to Sign-In Reorder', 'Split Layout Quick Companion Setup View', 'Account Session Safeguard Gateway View', 'Multi-Angle Photo Selection Helper Badge', 'Account Persistence Benefits Card Layout', 'Audio-Visual Generation Timer Callout']

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
Helpful changes: Preset fast-track adoption flows, moving sign-in immediately after pet adoption, photo quality assistant callouts, interactive progress tip carousels, split-view path layouts, and custom pet style selector views.
Worse performance: Pre-adoption photo prep screens, path decision speed helper callouts, path choice flexibility copy, desktop dock placement guidance banners, and desktop control action video cards.
No clear effect: Notifications, account sync/persistence banners and flows, subsequent sign-in reorders, desktop diagnostic flows, starter hubs, carousel path layouts, waiting hints/indicators, visibility prompts, and archetype selector flows.
Predictions were too low for photo quality assistant callouts, interactive progress carousels, split-view path selection screens, and custom pet style selector views.
Predictions were too high for preset fast-track adoption flows, sign-in reordering, split view story intros, and all tests showing no clear effect or negative performance.

Propose 10 NEW changes, different from everything above. Each must be testable as a 50/50 test.
Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.
            Existing screens, in their current order: ['story', 'choose_path', 'sign_in', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos', 'adoption_certificate', 'waiting', 'home_intro'].
            Fields on any screen: {'headline': 'str max 80', 'body': 'str max 240', 'hint': 'str max 160', 'button_label': 'str max 30', 'layout': 'str', 'show_progress': 'bool', 'show_time_estimate': 'bool', 'notify_when_ready': 'bool', 'show_step_counter': 'bool', 'tip_delay_seconds': 'int max 60', 'components': 'list max 12', 'replace': 'dict'}. "layout" is one of ['card', 'carousel', 'centered', 'checklist', 'compact', 'default', 'full_bleed', 'grid', 'list', 'split', 'spotlight', 'stage', 'story_scroll', 'two_column'].
            "components" is a list of new elements added to the screen, each {"type": one of ['animation', 'badge', 'button', 'checklist', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'mascot', 'name_input', 'photo_picker', 'preview', 'progress', 'sound', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel', 'video'],
            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: Stage Layout Desktop Companion Welcome Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the final home intro screen using a stage layout with a prominent companion mascot display and explicit tray-control guidance badges.
candidates.why: 35.2% of users drop off at the final step (finish conversion 64.8%), and support received multiple tickets regarding post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide the pet.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Live on Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Your pet is now active in your taskbar. Use quick hotkeys or right-click the system tray icon anytime to interact or hide them.

home_welcome.text: Welcome to your desktop companion setup!

candidates.title: Pre-Upload Style Inspection View
candidates.change: Add a new screen prior to photo uploading where users can inspect visual rendering style samples.
candidates.why: Adoption stage has a high mean duration (1017s) and 75.3% conversion, while users reported custom pet rendering output looking unexpected.

new_style_inspection.headline: Choose Visual Render Aesthetics
new_style_inspection.body: Preview how your companion will be drawn on your desktop before uploading reference images.

candidates.title: Early Companion Choice Flow Order
candidates.change: Move friend selection immediately after the story screen before choosing between preset or custom paths.
candidates.why: Choose path screen has a long mean time of 514s; presenting tangible pet options first creates immediate emotional connection before path selection.

choose_path.headline: How Would You Like to Adopt Your Selected Friend?
choose_path.body: Pick a preset companion template or create a unique custom creation.

candidates.title: Full Bleed Interactive Waiting Stage
candidates.change: Transform the waiting room into a full bleed animated stage displaying progress animation with interactive sound samples.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a high mean completion time of 2336s; engaging full-bleed visual feedback reduces perceived drop-off during generation.

waiting.headline: Creating Your Desktop Companion...
waiting.body: We are crafting your pet's desktop sprites and animations.

candidates.title: Desktop Quick Controls Action Badges
candidates.change: Add desktop interaction badges directly on the final welcome screen demonstrating mouse click actions and shortcuts.
candidates.why: Support logs indicate users are confused after setup on how to interact, speak to, or hide their pet on the desktop.

home_intro.hint: Tip: Double-click pet to talk, click & drag to move across monitors, right-click to hide.

candidates.title: Two Column Path Comparison View
candidates.change: Switch choose_path screen layout to two_column with visual card components highlighting instant preset vs custom creation.
candidates.why: Conversion on choose_path is 83.5% with a long mean duration of 514s, indicating decision paralysis.

components.text: Instant Adoption vs Custom Photo Generation

candidates.title: Account Pet Lock Copy Reinforcement
candidates.change: Update sign-in screen messaging to clearly assure users that signing in locks and saves their pet profile safely.
candidates.why: Top support theme (8 emails) concerns pets missing or resetting after sign-in.

sign_in.headline: Lock Your Pet Profile to Your Account
sign_in.body: Signing in ensures your desktop companion, settings, and memory are securely saved to the cloud so you never lose your pet.

candidates.title: Interactive Generation Sound & Visual Progress
candidates.change: Enable time estimates and add an active tip carousel on the waiting screen explaining background rendering behavior.
candidates.why: Home waiting stage has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, with support issues reporting stalling and launch confusion.

components.text: Your pet will automatically pop up on your primary monitor when generation finishes.

candidates.title: Official Adoption Seal Verification Callout
candidates.change: Add an official adoption seal badge component and incentive copy on the certificate screen.
candidates.why: Adoption completion drops to 75.3% with long times (1017s mean); rewarding completion boosts motivation to proceed to waiting.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Adoption Certificate Ready
adoption_certificate.body: Your official pet companion registration is finalized. Proceed to spawn your pet on your desktop.

candidates.title: Interactive Companion Onboarding Teaser Screen
candidates.change: Insert a new introductory screen showing interactive companion desktop animations before path selection.
candidates.why: Mean time in choose_path step is 514s; demonstrating live desktop behavior early sets clear expectations.

new_desktop_teaser.headline: Meet Your Desktop Companion
new_desktop_teaser.body: Watch how your pet lives, plays, and stays on your screen while you work.
